name: idea-factory
description: AI-driven insights for Indian equities (NSE/BSE). Provides stock analysis, daily views, and research briefs without investment advice.

skills.name: today
skills.description: Get today's view for a stock -- price movement, volume, and sector context

skills.name: brief
skills.description: Get a Peter Lynch-style investment research brief for analysis purposes

skills.name: explain

examples: @idea-factory which IT stocks have high PE ratios?
@idea-factory what are the top sectors today?
